county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection a caregiver was observed to be alone with a group of children when the conditions of their background check stated that they cannot be alone with a child or group of children.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence shows that a caregiver used inappropriate discipline on their own child while in care.  Employee was terminated.

top_violation_types.title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A Caregiver admitted to smoking a vape cigarette in the breakroom of the facility   while children were present.

top_violation_types.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection the nap cots were set up in a way that did not provide adequate space for caregivers to walk and work in between.
